_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 0 of 74 recent 12h windows moved ±2+ points and no catalyst has arrived to break the coil, so the skilled call is to hold with conviction until the breaker reveals itself.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree the market is coiling and a directional break has not yet occurred; they diverge on how much weight to give the August 2024 analog as a forward signal, with the analyst treating it as conditional and the narrative treating it as a stronger tell.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 54 with btc_momentum confirming above 55 and funding staying controlled below 60, signaling Disbelief-phase entry
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 38 with vix spiking above 80 and btc_momentum falling below 35, pushing toward Panic
